_meta.title: Trade & Logistics domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/trade.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing trade.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/trade.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.mirrors: assets/data/deep/finance-connectivity-recommendations.json and energy-connectivity-recommendations.json (same method, same audit module)
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: MILDER than Finance/Energy on recurrence, WORSE on hubs. TRADE DIFFERENCE #1: the graph is NOT purely feedforward — it already carries 2 reciprocal pairs (ECN<->HIPP, CBLM<->THAL), so recurrentFraction is 0.077 (Finance and Energy were exactly 0). TRADE DIFFERENCE #2: the graph is a SINGLE connected component at baseline (baseComponents 1), unlike Finance which was pre-fractured into 2. TRADE DIFFERENCE #3 (the fault that IS worse): 11 articulation nodes (Finance 9), driven by one very heavy hub — removing THAL shatters the graph into 4 components, because the entire motor/relay cluster {M1, SMA, S1, CBLM}, the auditory island {A1, MGN}, and the basal-ganglia gate {STRI, GP} all hang off THAL alone.

recurrenceAudit.note: NON-ZERO reciprocity (2 pairs) distinguishes Trade from Finance/Energy (both 0). ECN<->HIPP (HIPP->ECN SUPPLIES + ECN->HIPP CONTROLS — the inventory<->warehouse self-correcting loop) and CBLM<->THAL (THAL->CBLM SUPPLIES + CBLM->THAL excit — the rail/port timing loop) are the two pre-existing feedback pairs. recurrentFraction 0.077 still sits far below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark; lateralFractionOfClassifiable 0.333 clears the 0.2 lateral threshold, which is why the module verdict is 'has recurrent/lateral structure' despite the near-absent feedback dimension.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE connected component at baseline (all 36 edge-endpoint nodes reachable). This is HEALTHIER than Finance (2 components; Finance had a fully-detached {M1,SMA} dyad). In Trade the motor cluster is attached — but only through THAL, which is the problem below.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: THE CRITICAL HUB (removal -> 4 components). Sole attachment of THREE clusters: (1) the motor/relay cluster {M1, SMA, S1, CBLM} — its only links to the body are THAL->M1, THAL->S1, THAL<->CBLM; (2) the auditory island {A1, MGN} — A1's only body link is THAL->A1, MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge; (3) the basal-ganglia gate {STRI, GP} — GP->THAL is its only link out, STRI->GP is STRI's only edge. NOTE: unlike Finance, the visual pair {V1, LGN} does NOT hang off THAL, because FEF->V1 keeps V1 attached independently.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: sole attachment of leaf SMA (SMA->M1 is SMA's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dlPFC: sole attachment of leaf FPN (FPN->dlPFC is FPN's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: removal -> 3 components: sole attachment of leaf VTA (VTA->NAcc is VTA's only edge) AND leaf VP (NAcc->VP is VP's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1 is LGN's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaf PI (PI->AI is PI's only edge); NTS also touches AI but stays attached via NTS->THAL and CC->NTS, so only PI is isolated
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: sole attachment of leaf STRI (STRI->GP is STRI's only edge)

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens (last-mile delivery reporting delivery-endpoint state back to the port/routing gate).
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, 'somatosensory relay'). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, 'visual sensory relay'). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, 'auditory sensory relay'). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal (commodity-futures variance) feeds back to the supply-chain executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit, 'executive recruits conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the trade-agreement context/brake feeds back onto customs outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (SUPPLIES). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the customs/valuation stage feeds back to the commodity-exchange reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit, 'reward -> value coding'). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the cortico-thalamic executive loop that the existing dlPFC->THAL (CONTROLS) opens: the routing hub feeds the supply-chain executive and the executive gates the hub.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->THAL (CONTROLS). The mediodorsal thalamus projects densely to lateral PFC (canonical thalamo-prefrontal relay). canonical-nodes THAL = M4 routing hub, dlPFC = executive.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the hippocampal-HPA homeostatic negative-feedback loop that the existing HYPO->HIPP (REGULATES) opens: the warehouse/memory index feeds inhibitory feedback back onto the cold-chain homeostatic set-point.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge HYPO->HIPP (REGULATES). canonical-nodes HIPP = M3 'HPA feedback + memory index', HYPO = M3 'homeostatic set-point'; the hippocampus provides canonical glucocorticoid negative feedback onto the HPA axis (an existing HIPP->PVN inhib edge already encodes the same feedback role). Strongest homeostatic grounding of the set.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the motor/relay cluster {M1, SMA, S1, CBLM} — which hangs off THAL alone — to the main body via a fronto-motor edge into SMA. DOUBLE DUTY: also de-articulates M1 (SMA's only current edge is SMA->M1, so removing M1 isolates SMA; this second SMA afferent fixes that too).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes dlPFC = 'executive working-memory / cognitive control', SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'. The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex projects to premotor/supplementary motor cortex to bias action selection (canonical fronto-premotor projection); dlPFC is a main-body hub in-graph.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the auditory cortex a cortical anchor off THAL, reattaching the auditory island {A1, MGN} to the main body when THAL is removed.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing', AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience). AI is a main-body node in-graph (NTS->AI, PI->AI, AI->dACC).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the basal-ganglia gate {STRI, GP} — which reaches the body only via GP->THAL — through a corticostriatal edge into STRI. DOUBLE DUTY: also de-articulates GP (STRI's only current edge is STRI->GP, so removing GP isolates STRI; this second STRI afferent fixes that too).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex sends a canonical glutamatergic corticostriatal projection to the striatum (goal-directed cortico-basal-ganglia loop). canonical-nodes dlPFC = executive. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks STRI as a COMPOSITE view (remapTo 'view' = CAUD+PUT+NAcc, 'not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap STRI to its components rather than treat it as a node — the edge is grounded on the corticostriatal projection regardless.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view ('not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway. CeA is a main-body node in-graph (mPFC->CeA, vmPFC->CeA).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: VP reaches the graph only via NAcc->VP, so removing NAcc isolates it. The reward-loop closure edge VP->VTA gives VP a second anchor; removing NAcc then leaves VP attached via VTA. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: NAcc splits into TWO leaves on removal: VP (fixed above via VP->VTA) and VTA (VTA->NAcc is VTA's only edge). This edge reattaches the VTA leaf: a mesocortical dopamine projection gives VTA a second target; removing NAcc then leaves VTA attached via OFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The ventral tegmental area sends a canonical mesocortical dopaminergic projection to orbitofrontal / prefrontal cortex (dopamine modulates valuation). canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'. OFC is a main-body node in-graph. type modul (dopaminergic gain).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 'top-down brake'. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PI reaches the graph only via PI->AI, so removing AI isolates it. A posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor; removing AI then leaves PI attached via dACC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

projectedImpact.method: The 18 proposed edges (9 feedback + 9 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of trade.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. trade.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 9 added feedback edges each reverse a pre-existing edge, adding 9 reciprocal pairs on top of the 2 already present (ECN<->HIPP, CBLM<->THAL) = 11 pairs = 22 reciprocal-counted edges. The 9 redundant edges add 0 reciprocals.

baseComponents.note: already a single component; the redundant edges do not change component count, they remove articulation (single-point-of-failure) brittleness within the one component.

articulationNodes.reason: All three residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: dlPFC still cuts off the composite-view leaf FPN; V1 still cuts off LGN; A1 still cuts off MGN. NOTE the TRADE DIFFERENCE from Finance: Trade CLEARED THAL from the articulation set (its three clusters had groundable second anchors — motor via dlPFC->SMA, basal-ganglia via dlPFC->STRI, auditory via A1->AI), whereas Finance bottomed out at THAL/V1/A1. Trade's residual dlPFC (via FPN) is the new floor member, because FPN is a control-network composite view with no grounded second in-graph target.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around dlPFC via a second edge on FPN
candidates.reason: FPN reaches the graph only via FPN->dlPFC. canonical-nodes marks FPN as a COMPOSITE view (remapTo 'view' = dlPFC+IPS, 'not an edge endpoint'); its grounded parietal partner IPS is not present as a node in the trade graph, so there is no honest second projection target. FPN stays a leaf of dlPFC and dlPFC stays a residual articulation point for it. The cleaner long-run fix is to remap FPN to its components rather than treat it as a node.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the trade graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1. (The A1->AI edge above reattaches A1/MGN when THAL is removed, but does not give MGN a path that survives removal of A1 itself.)

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: S1->M1 (dense reciprocal somatomotor connectivity) is groundable and would give THAL's S1 leaf a second anchor, but it was unnecessary: dlPFC->SMA already reconnects the whole {M1, SMA, S1, CBLM} cluster (S1 rides along via M1->S1), so THAL clears the articulation set without it. Recorded as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding.
